issues.idiom: 人不可貌相，海水不可斗量
issues.problem: bad[1] (a garment that looks cheap but is expensive) is only a stretch, not clearly wrong: speakers do jokingly extend 人不可貌相 to things
issues.action: Replaced it with 第一次见面一定要穿得体面，{…}: the saying is used to back advice that looks are what count, the opposite of its meaning; new en and why

issues.problem: use.reg was 'spoken', but the saying is just as common in writing (essays, articles, teachers' comments)
issues.action: Changed reg to 'neutral'. Story kept: 《红楼梦》第九回 does use 三日打鱼，两日晒网 of Xue Pan, who went to the family school only for show

issues.problem: Story checked against 《宋史·晏敦复传》: Qin Hui sent word that he could reach the two top posts if he gave way; Yan Dunfu replied that he would not harm the state for his own sake, his nature being like ginger and cassia, which grow hotter with age (姜桂之性，到老愈辣)

Stories are null, and none of these sayings has a single origin certain enough to add. Meanings, literal senses, register, tone, near notes, cues, parts and misuses checked; contexts checked against same-set near-synonyms (路遥知马力 and 是金子总会发光 for sy011, 一口吃不成胖子 for sy015, sy012/sy018 against each other) and each context fits only its own saying
